rec.name: My Account Order History Invoice PDF Download
rec.status: Built — live (confirmed in ticket comment, Oct 2025)

what.text: The order history table in the customer's My Account area has an extra 'Invoices' column. Each order row shows a PDF icon and a 'Download invoice as PDF' link. The table columns are Order, Date, Payment status, Invoices and Total. The screenshot shows order #1005, dated 6 October 2025, with payment status 'Pending' and a total of €9.99.

why.text: Self-service access to invoices makes the shop look professional and transparent, which builds trust after purchase. It also cuts support requests such as 'please send me my invoice'. Business and B2B buyers often need a proper invoice before they can reorder or get reimbursed, so this lowers friction for repeat purchases. It is a post-purchase retention and trust feature, not a direct conversion driver.

how.text: The ticket confirms that invoices are shown per order in My Account, but not how they are generated or uploaded. Likely approaches: (1) an invoice app that attaches a PDF to each order and exposes it in the customer account, or (2) a custom column in the account order table (customers/account.liquid, or a customer account UI extension) that links to a PDF stored in an order metafield or file. This is not confirmed in the source and needs verification.

items: Invoices column shown in the order history table
Whether the link appears only once an invoice exists (assumed)

dependencies.text: Needs a customer account area with an order history table. Needs per-order invoice PDFs, generated by an invoice app or stored in an order metafield or file. The ticket does not say which. The theme must allow customisation of the account order table.

items: Repeat purchase rate of B2B and business customers
